下面是我的优化判断和一个可直接落地的 gpt55-ctl.ps1。
1. 哪里要大改
A. 队列状态模型要大改
你现在的问题本质是：gpt-ask.ps1 超时后，服务端仍在处理，但客户端只知道 GPT_UNAVAILABLE。这说明队列缺少“任务生命周期”。
建议把文件队列拆成：
gpt-queue\├─ inbox\ # 等待处理├─ processing\ # 正在处理├─ outbox\ # 已完成├─ failed\ # 失败├─ deadletter\ # 超过重试/过期├─ cancelled\ # 客户端取消└─ locks\
每个请求 JSON 必须有：
JSON{ "id": "20260701-090000-abc123", "priority": 100, "status": "queued", "createdAt": "...", "deadlineAt": "...", "clientTimeoutSec": 300, "serverTimeoutSec": 900, "retries": 0, "maxRetries": 1}
服务端流程应该是：
inbox → processing → outbox ↘ failed/deadletter
不要让旧请求永久堵住新请求。processing 中超过 serverTimeoutSec 的请求要自动转 failed 或 deadletter。

B. gpt-ask.ps1 要大改超时语义
现在超时返回 GPT_UNAVAILABLE 是误导性的。正确语义应该分三种：
服务器没启动：GPT_SERVER_DOWN请求已排队但客户端等待超时：GPT_PENDING服务器明确失败：GPT_FAILED
客户端超时不代表服务器不可用，也不代表任务失败。
建议 gpt-ask.ps1 支持：
PowerShellgpt-ask.ps1 ask "..." # 提交并等待gpt-ask.ps1 status <requestId> # 查询状态gpt-ask.ps1 fetch <requestId> # 获取结果gpt-ask.ps1 cancel <requestId> # 取消任务
等待超时时输出：
JSON{ "status": "pending", "requestId": "...", "message": "客户端等待超时，但服务器可能仍在处理。可稍后 fetch。"}

C. 服务端要加 watchdog/heartbeat
gpt55-server.js 必须持续写：
JSON{ "ready": true, "busy": false, "pid": 12345, "startedAt": "...", "updatedAt": "...", "currentRequestId": null, "browser": "chromium", "lastError": null}
并且处理任务时每隔几秒更新 heartbeat。否则控制脚本无法判断它是“正在处理”还是“卡死”。

D. 队列优先级要大改
旧请求堵新请求，说明目前可能按文件创建时间处理。
建议排序规则：
priority DESCcreatedAt ASC
文件名也可以加前缀，便于肉眼看：
p100-20260701-090000-abc123.request.jsonp050-20260701-090005-def456.request.jsonp010-20260701-090010-ghi789.request.json
老板/紧急任务用 priority=100，普通任务 50，后台任务 10。
2. 哪里小修即可
A. start-server.ps1 小修即可，建议替换为统一 gpt55-ctl.ps1
不要再维护多个启动脚本。统一为：
PowerShellgpt55-ctl.ps1 startgpt55-ctl.ps1 stopgpt55-ctl.ps1 restartgpt55-ctl.ps1 statusgpt55-ctl.ps1 cleangpt55-ctl.ps1 tail
B. gpt55-server.js 启动前清理残留状态，小修即可
保留你已加的 cleanupStaleState()，但要区分：
server.lock：可清processing 超时文件：转 failed/deadletter，不要直接删inbox：不要随便清，除非 restart --clean-inboxoutbox：不要清，保留结果
C. Chromium 固定使用，小修即可
你已经把 Edge 改成 Chromium，这个方向对。
Playwright 启动建议固定：
JavaScriptchromium.launchPersistentContext(profileDir, { channel: undefined, headless: false, args: [ "--disable-dev-shm-usage", "--no-first-run", "--no-default-browser-check" ]})
D. 日志要小修
每个请求单独日志：
logs\├─ server.log├─ requests\│ ├─ requestId.log
这样 GPT 崩溃时能定位是哪一个 prompt 触发。
3. 更好的架构替代
短期最稳：继续文件队列，但补状态机
你现在最快能落地的是：
文件队列 + requestId + priority + processing timeout + status/fetch/cancel
不用马上换架构。
中期推荐：本地 HTTP 服务 + SQLite
更干净的架构：
gpt-ask.ps1→ POST http://127.0.0.1:9555/jobs→ gpt55-server.js 写 SQLite jobs 表→ worker 处理→ GET /jobs/{id}
SQLite 表：
jobs(id, priority, status, prompt, response, error, created_at, started_at, finished_at, deadline_at)
优点：
不会被文件残留搞乱状态查询简单优先级排序简单超时/重试简单支持多个客户端
长期推荐：浏览器 Worker 和 API Server 分离
现在 gpt55-server.js 同时做 API、队列、浏览器自动化、DOM 提取，1443 行太重。
建议拆成：
gpt55-api.js # 接收请求/状态查询gpt55-worker.js # 队列消费browser-session.js # 登录/选通道/发prompt/读回复queue-store.js # 文件队列或SQLitesite-adapter-nbai.js # ai.nbai88.top DOM适配
最关键是 site-adapter-nbai.js。中转站 DOM 一变，只改 adapter，不动核心队列。
4. 可靠版 gpt55-ctl.ps1
保存到：
D:\Code\ai-pipeline\gpt55-ctl.ps1
PowerShell<#.SYNOPSISGPT-5.5 管道控制脚本。.DESCRIPTION用于管理 D:\Code\ai-pipeline\gpt55-server.js。命令： status 查看服务状态 start 启动服务，不杀旧进程 stop 停止当前项目的 gpt55-server.js 进程 restart 停止服务、清理残留、重新启动、等待 ready clean 清理锁文件和残留 processing，可选清理 inbox tail 查看最新日志设计原则： - 默认只杀当前项目的 node 服务 - 默认只杀使用 browser-profile 的浏览器进程 - 不默认清空 inbox，避免误删未处理任务 - restart 会删除旧 server-status.json，避免误判 ready - 等待 ready=true busy=false#>[CmdletBinding()]param( [ValidateSet("status", "start", "stop", "restart", "clean", "tail")] [string]$Command = "status", [string]$ProjectRoot = "D:\Code\ai-pipeline", [string]$ServerScriptName = "gpt55-server.js", [int]$ReadyTimeoutSeconds = 20, [switch]$CleanInbox, [switch]$HardKillAllBrowsers)Set-StrictMode -Version Latest$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"# -----------------------------# 路径配置# -----------------------------$ProjectRoot = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ProjectRoot)$ServerScript = Join-Path $ProjectRoot $ServerScriptName$QueueDir = Join-Path $ProjectRoot "gpt-queue"$InboxDir = Join-Path $QueueDir "inbox"$ProcessingDir = Join-Path $QueueDir "processing"$OutboxDir = Join-Path $QueueDir "outbox"$FailedDir = Join-Path $QueueDir "failed"$DeadLetterDir = Join-Path $QueueDir "deadletter"$LocksDir = Join-Path $QueueDir "locks"$ServerLock = Join-Path $QueueDir "server.lock"$BrowserProfileDir = Join-Path $ProjectRoot "browser-profile"$BrowserSingletonLock = Join-Path $BrowserProfileDir "SingletonLock"# 兼容两种位置：优先根目录 server-status.json，其次 gpt-queue\server-status.json$RootStatusFile = Join-Path $ProjectRoot "server-status.json"$QueueStatusFile = Join-Path $QueueDir "server-status.json"$LogDir = Join-Path $ProjectRoot "logs"$CtlLog = Join-Path $LogDir "gpt55-ctl.log"# -----------------------------# 通用函数# -----------------------------function Ensure-Directory { param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path) if (-not (Test-Path $Path -PathType Container)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force | Out-Null }}function Write-CtlLog { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Message, [ValidateSet("INFO", "WARN", "ERROR")][string]$Level = "INFO" ) Ensure-Directory -Path $LogDir $line = "[{0}] [{1}] {2}" -f (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), $Level, $Message Add-Content -Path $CtlLog -Value $line -Encoding UTF8 Write-Host $line}function Assert-Environment { if (-not (Test-Path $ProjectRoot -PathType Container)) { throw "项目目录不存在：$ProjectRoot" } if (-not (Test-Path $ServerScript -PathType Leaf)) { throw "服务脚本不存在：$ServerScript" } $node = Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue if ($null -eq $node) { throw "未找到 node，请确认 Node.js 已安装并在 PATH 中。" } Ensure-Directory -Path $QueueDir Ensure-Directory -Path $InboxDir Ensure-Directory -Path $ProcessingDir Ensure-Directory -Path $OutboxDir Ensure-Directory -Path $FailedDir Ensure-Directory -Path $DeadLetterDir Ensure-Directory -Path $LocksDir Ensure-Directory -Path $BrowserProfileDir Ensure-Directory -Path $LogDir}function Resolve-StatusFile { if (Test-Path $RootStatusFile -PathType Leaf) { return $RootStatusFile } if (Test-Path $QueueStatusFile -PathType Leaf) { return $QueueStatusFile } # 默认写根目录状态文件，和你现有控制脚本兼容。 return $RootStatusFile}function Read-ServerStatus { $statusFile = Resolve-StatusFile if (-not (Test-Path $statusFile -PathType Leaf)) { return $null } try { return Get-Content -Path $statusFile -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { Write-CtlLog "读取状态文件失败：$statusFile；原因：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" return $null }}function Remove-StatusFiles { foreach ($file in @($RootStatusFile, $QueueStatusFile)) { if (Test-Path $file -PathType Leaf) { try { Remove-Item -Path $file -Force Write-CtlLog "已删除旧状态文件：$file" } catch { Write-CtlLog "删除状态文件失败：$file；原因：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } } }}function Test-ReadyIdle { param($Status) if ($null -eq $Status) { return $false } if (-not $Status.PSObject.Properties["ready"]) { return $false } if (-not $Status.PSObject.Properties["busy"]) { return $false } return (($Status.ready -eq $true) -and ($Status.busy -eq $false))}function Get-ServerProcesses { $escapedScript = [regex]::Escape($ServerScriptName) $escapedRoot = [regex]::Escape($ProjectRoot) return @( Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'node.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -match $escapedScript -and $_.CommandLine -match $escapedRoot } )}function Get-BrowserProcessesForProfile { $escapedProfile = [regex]::Escape($BrowserProfileDir) return @( Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -in @("chrome.exe", "msedge.exe", "chromium.exe") -and $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -match $escapedProfile } )}function Stop-ProcessByCim { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)]$ProcessInfo, [string]$Reason = "" ) try { Write-CtlLog "结束进程：$($ProcessInfo.Name) PID=$($ProcessInfo.ProcessId) $Reason" Stop-Process -Id $ProcessInfo.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-CtlLog "结束进程失败：PID=$($ProcessInfo.ProcessId)；原因：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" }}# -----------------------------# 状态# -----------------------------function Show-Status { Assert-Environment $statusFile = Resolve-StatusFile $status = Read-ServerStatus $serverProcesses = Get-ServerProcesses $browserProcesses = Get-BrowserProcessesForProfile $inboxCount = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $InboxDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count $processingCount = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $ProcessingDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count $outboxCount = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $OutboxDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count $failedCount = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $FailedDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count $deadCount = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $DeadLetterDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count Write-Host "" Write-Host "====== GPT-5.5 管道状态 ======" -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host "项目目录：$ProjectRoot" Write-Host "服务脚本：$ServerScript" Write-Host "状态文件：$statusFile" Write-Host "" Write-Host "进程：" -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host " gpt55-server.js node 进程数：$($serverProcesses.Count)" foreach ($p in $serverProcesses) { Write-Host " - node PID=$($p.ProcessId)" } Write-Host " browser-profile 浏览器进程数：$($browserProcesses.Count)" foreach ($p in $browserProcesses) { Write-Host " - $($p.Name) PID=$($p.ProcessId)" } Write-Host "" Write-Host "队列：" -ForegroundColor Cyan Write-Host " inbox ：$inboxCount" Write-Host " processing ：$processingCount" Write-Host " outbox ：$outboxCount" Write-Host " failed ：$failedCount" Write-Host " deadletter ：$deadCount" Write-Host "" Write-Host "server-status.json：" -ForegroundColor Cyan if ($null -eq $status) { Write-Host " 未找到或无法读取。" -ForegroundColor Yellow } else { $ready = if ($status.PSObject.Properties["ready"]) { $status.ready } else { "missing" } $busy = if ($status.PSObject.Properties["busy"]) { $status.busy } else { "missing" } Write-Host " ready：$ready" Write-Host " busy ：$busy" if ($status.PSObject.Properties["pid"]) { Write-Host " pid ：$($status.pid)" } if ($status.PSObject.Properties["currentRequestId"]) { Write-Host " currentRequestId：$($status.currentRequestId)" } if ($status.PSObject.Properties["updatedAt"]) { Write-Host " updatedAt：$($status.updatedAt)" } if ($status.PSObject.Properties["lastError"] -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$status.lastError)) { Write-Host " lastError：$($status.lastError)" -ForegroundColor Red } } Write-Host "================================" Write-Host "" if (Test-ReadyIdle -Status $status) { return 0 } return 1}# -----------------------------# 清理# -----------------------------function Move-OldProcessingToFailed { param( [int]$OlderThanMinutes = 30 ) Ensure-Directory -Path $FailedDir $cutoff = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(-1 * $OlderThanMinutes) $files = Get-ChildItem -Path $ProcessingDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -lt $cutoff } foreach ($file in $files) { try { $target = Join-Path $FailedDir $file.Name if (Test-Path $target -PathType Leaf) { $target = Join-Path $FailedDir ("{0}.{1}{2}" -f $file.BaseName, (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"), $file.Extension) } Move-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $target -Force Write-CtlLog "已将过期 processing 转移到 failed：$($file.Name)" } catch { Write-CtlLog "转移 processing 失败：$($file.FullName)；原因：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } }}function Clear-StaleState { param( [switch]$RemoveInbox ) Write-CtlLog "开始清理残留状态。" if (Test-Path $BrowserSingletonLock -PathType Leaf) { try { Remove-Item -Path $BrowserSingletonLock -Force Write-CtlLog "已删除 SingletonLock：$BrowserSingletonLock" } catch { Write-CtlLog "删除 SingletonLock 失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } } if (Test-Path $ServerLock -PathType Leaf) { try { Remove-Item -Path $ServerLock -Force Write-CtlLog "已删除 server.lock：$ServerLock" } catch { Write-CtlLog "删除 server.lock 失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } } # 只清理 processing，不默认清 inbox。 try { Get-ChildItem -Path $ProcessingDir -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop Write-CtlLog "已清空 processing：$ProcessingDir" } catch { Write-CtlLog "清空 processing 失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } if ($RemoveInbox) { try { Get-ChildItem -Path $InboxDir -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop Write-CtlLog "已清空 inbox：$InboxDir" } catch { Write-CtlLog "清空 inbox 失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } } else { Write-CtlLog "未清空 inbox。若确认要清理，请使用 -CleanInbox。" } Remove-StatusFiles Write-CtlLog "残留状态清理完成。"}# -----------------------------# 启停# -----------------------------function Stop-Server { Assert-Environment Write-CtlLog "开始停止 GPT-5.5 服务。" $serverProcesses = Get-ServerProcesses foreach ($p in $serverProcesses) { Stop-ProcessByCim -ProcessInfo $p -Reason "(gpt55-server.js)" } $browserProcesses = Get-BrowserProcessesForProfile foreach ($p in $browserProcesses) { Stop-ProcessByCim -ProcessInfo $p -Reason "(browser-profile)" } if ($HardKillAllBrowsers) { Write-CtlLog "HardKillAllBrowsers 已启用，将结束所有 chrome/msedge/chromium 进程。" "WARN" $allBrowsers = @( Get-Process -Name chrome, msedge, chromium -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue ) foreach ($p in $allBrowsers) { try { Write-CtlLog "强制结束浏览器：$($p.ProcessName) PID=$($p.Id)" Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force } catch { Write-CtlLog "强制结束浏览器失败：PID=$($p.Id)；原因：$($_.Exception.Message)" "WARN" } } } Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 Write-CtlLog "停止完成。"}function Start-Server { Assert-Environment $running = Get-ServerProcesses if ($running.Count -gt 0) { Write-CtlLog "服务已在运行，不重复启动。" [void](Show-Status) return } $node = Get-Command node -ErrorAction Stop $stamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss" $stdoutLog = Join-Path $LogDir "gpt55-server-$stamp.out.log" $stderrLog = Join-Path $LogDir "gpt55-server-$stamp.err.log" # 避免旧 ready=true 误判。 Remove-StatusFiles Write-CtlLog "启动服务：node $ServerScriptName" Write-CtlLog "stdout：$stdoutLog" Write-CtlLog "stderr：$stderrLog" $process = Start-Process ` -FilePath $node.Source ` -ArgumentList @($ServerScriptName) ` -WorkingDirectory $ProjectRoot ` -RedirectStandardOutput $stdoutLog ` -RedirectStandardError $stderrLog ` -NoNewWindow ` -PassThru Write-CtlLog "已启动 gpt55-server.js，PID=$($process.Id)" Wait-Ready -Pid $process.Id -StdoutLog $stdoutLog -StderrLog $stderrLog}function Wait-Ready { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][int]$Pid, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$StdoutLog, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$StderrLog ) $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($ReadyTimeoutSeconds) Write-CtlLog "等待服务 ready=true busy=false，超时 $ReadyTimeoutSeconds 秒。" while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 $proc = Get-Process -Id $Pid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue if ($null -eq $proc) { throw "gpt55-server.js 已退出。请查看日志：$StderrLog" } $status = Read-ServerStatus if (Test-ReadyIdle -Status $status) { Write-CtlLog "服务就绪：ready=true busy=false。" return } } $lastStatus = Read-ServerStatus Write-Host "" Write-Host "启动失败：超时后仍未看到 ready=true busy=false。" -ForegroundColor Red Write-Host "stdout：$StdoutLog" Write-Host "stderr：$StderrLog" if ($null -ne $lastStatus) { Write-Host "" Write-Host "最后状态：" -ForegroundColor Yellow $lastStatus | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 } else { Write-Host "" Write-Host "没有生成 server-status.json。" -ForegroundColor Yellow } throw "服务启动超时。"}function Restart-Server { Assert-Environment Write-CtlLog "开始 restart。" Stop-Server Clear-StaleState -RemoveInbox:$CleanInbox Start-Server Write-CtlLog "restart 完成。"}# -----------------------------# 日志# -----------------------------function Show-Tail { Assert-Environment $logs = Get-ChildItem -Path $LogDir -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 5 if ($logs.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host "没有日志文件：$LogDir" -ForegroundColor Yellow return } Write-Host "最近日志文件：" -ForegroundColor Cyan foreach ($log in $logs) { Write-Host "- $($log.FullName)" } $latest = $logs | Select-Object -First 1 Write-Host "" Write-Host "====== Tail: $($latest.Name) ======" -ForegroundColor Cyan Get-Content -Path $latest.FullName -Tail 80 -Encoding UTF8}# -----------------------------# 主入口# -----------------------------try { switch ($Command) { "status" { $code = Show-Status exit $code } "start" { Start-Server exit 0 } "stop" { Stop-Server exit 0 } "restart" { Restart-Server exit 0 } "clean" { Assert-Environment Clear-StaleState -RemoveInbox:$CleanInbox exit 0 } "tail" { Show-Tail exit 0 } }}catch { Write-CtlLog "命令失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" "ERROR" Write-Host "" Write-Host "命令失败：$($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red exit 1}
建议你下一步马上做的修改
按优先级：
1. 用 gpt55-ctl.ps1 统一替换 start-server.ps1。2. gpt-ask.ps1 超时不要返回 GPT_UNAVAILABLE，改成返回 requestId + pending。3. gpt55-server.js 处理请求时写 heartbeat/currentRequestId。4. inbox 读取按 priority DESC + createdAt ASC 排序。5. processing 超时转 failed/deadletter，不要永久堵队列。6. 把 ai.nbai88.top 的 DOM 选择器抽到 site-adapter-nbai.js。7. 后续再考虑 SQLite/HTTP API 替代文件队列。
最小改动能立刻见效的是：先上 gpt55-ctl.ps1，再修 gpt-ask.ps1 的超时语义，最后给队列加 priority 和 processing 超时回收。
